![list](196,257,727,281)
- Select tuples of the loan relation where the branch name is “GMU”.

![formula](344,283,527,307) $\sigma_{\text{branch} = 'GMU'} (\text{loan})$

![list](193,316,706,339)
- Find all tuples in which the amount of loan is more than \$12000.

![formula](252,338,430,364) $\sigma_{\text{amount} > 12000} (\text{loan})$

![list](191,375,846,400)
- Find those tuples pertaining to loans of more than \$ 12000 made by “GMU” branch.

![formula](247,401,757,429) $\sigma_{\text{amount} > 12000 \text{ AND } \text{branch} = 'GMU'} (\text{loan}) \quad \text{or} \quad R_1 \cap R_2$

![list](189,435,559,455)
- List all loan numbers and the amount of loan.

![formula](250,457,462,485) $\pi_{\text{loan\#}, \text{amount}} \quad \text{loan}$

![list](189,495,614,515)
- Find the names of all customers who live in “Fairfax”.

![formula](264,516,593,546) $\pi_{\text{name}} \left( \sigma_{\text{city} = 'Fairfax'} \right) (\text{customers})$

![list](188,555,850,575)
- Find the names of all bank customers who have either an account or a loan or both.

![formula](254,575,670,601) $\pi_{\text{name}} (\text{Depositor}) \cup \pi_{\text{name}} (\text{Borrower})$

![list](188,616,829,635)
- Find the names of all customers of the bank who have an account but not a loan.

![formula](264,638,647,668) $\pi_{\text{name}} (\text{Depositor}) - \pi_{\text{name}} (\text{Borrower})$

![list](187,677,753,694)
- Find the names of all customers who have both a loan and an account.

![formula](274,694,682,731) $\pi_{\text{name}} (\text{Depositor}) \cap \pi_{\text{name}} (\text{Borrower})$
